Database: Native PostgreSQL verification database only; generated schemas and Redis namespaces cleaned
OperatorChecks: Session user includes the current database operator flag; no email-based or first-signup promotion
Signup and profile JSON cannot promote an ordinary account using isOperator or roles
Anonymous management reads and writes receive 401; all non-operator endpoints receive 403 before private ID or query lookup
Grant and revoke are effective with the existing Redis cookie on the next request, including list, detail and PATCH
Management DTOs exclude account emails, passwords, CSRF/session values and publisher credentials
List status, reason and literal case-insensitive channel-name/handle/details search filters are bounded and validated
Opaque keyset cursor preserves PostgreSQL microseconds and UUID ordering across equal DTO milliseconds without duplicates or omissions
Review PATCH requires CSRF, matching Origin, exact fields, bounded note and integral nonnegative version
Concurrent writes of the same version yield one success and one REPORT_CONFLICT without lost updates
Received reports can be reviewed or closed; reviewing reports can be closed; same-state writes are rejected
Terminal results require a note and are immutable through the API; original reporter, target, reason, details and creation timestamp remain unchanged
Server records handler UUID, update time and incremented version; no moderation enforcement is simulated
Completed and dismissed reports still count toward original public report duplicate/rate rules
Review status, note, handler and version survive a fresh Spring Boot instance with the same login cookie
V6 backfills update time from receipt time and does not grant existing accounts operator access
V1 through V5 SQL hashes remain unchanged and checksum mismatch blocks synthetic pending V7
Notes: Operator flags were granted only on generated test accounts inside isolated verification schemas
Main application deployment, explicit user account grant and browser QA are performed separately by the root agent
No Docker execution, OBS/media process changes, automatic bans, generic RBAC or review audit event system were added
